summary: This Privacy Policy describes how Mirael (the “Service”, “we”, “us”, “our”) collects, uses, discloses, and protects personal information when you use the Mirael mobile and web applications designed to provide emotional reflection and clarity tools for adult users.
scope: Applies to all individuals who download, register for, or use Mirael. Does not create a therapeutic relationship; the Service is a self-help/emotional reflection tool.
key_principles: We minimize the personal data we collect.
We separate ephemeral session processing from persistent storage.
We treat sensitive emotional content with heightened safeguards.
We enable users to exercise rights to access, correct, export, and delete their data.

data_collection_categories.purpose: Account provisioning, authentication, account recovery, and support.

examples: Chat messages and text entered into reflection prompts
data_collection_categories.purpose: Core product functionality: emotional reflection, pattern detection, session continuity.

examples: Statements revealing emotional state, personal history, feelings, and interpersonal concerns
data_collection_categories.purpose: Processing to provide reflection, identify cognitive distortions, and suggest coping actions.
data_collection_categories.note: We treat this as sensitive in practice and apply additional safeguards, but do not label Mirael as a medical or mental health service.

examples: Client-side state stored via Zustand and localForage (session tokens, UI state, encrypted local caches)
data_collection_categories.purpose: Improve user experience, offline support, make Mirael appear stateful on-device.

examples: Analytics identifiers, aggregated engagement metrics from analytics providers, optional integration data
data_collection_categories.purpose: Product analytics and integrations used with user consent.

data_not_collected_or_disclaimed: We do not collect medical records or diagnose mental health conditions.
We do not collect payment card details directly (if payments are used, they are processed by third-party payment providers).

stateless_ai_usage.description: Mirael uses a stateless AI inference service (e.g., GPT-4o) to process text inputs for reflection and pattern recognition. Inputs are transmitted to the API for immediate processing and the AI returns outputs which may be logged transiently for quality and debugging.
stateless_ai_usage.transmission: Data transmitted to the AI provider is encrypted in transit.
stateless_ai_usage.storage: By default, the AI provider is treated as a processor; transient logs may be retained by the provider according to their policies. We will seek contracts that limit retention where technically possible.

local_state_explanation.description: To provide continuity, Mirael uses client-side state persistence (Zustand + localForage). Data stored locally remains on the user’s device unless the user explicitly syncs or exports it.
local_state_explanation.user_control: Users can clear local data through app settings; local storage is under user control and not automatically uploaded to our servers unless the user opts into backups or sync features.

applies_to: Marketing communications, optional analytics, optional integrations, and any processing of particularly sensitive content beyond core functionality
Product improvement, fraud detection, security, troubleshooting
Balancing test applied to ensure user rights are not overridden

legal_bases_and_legal_justification.note: Exact legal bases vary by jurisdiction. For users in the EU or other jurisdictions with specific rules, we will honor local legal requirements and provide jurisdiction-specific disclosures when required.

service_providers_processors.data_shared: Text inputs and necessary metadata for inference
service_providers_processors.contractual_controls: Processor agreements with security and retention obligations where possible

service_providers_processors.data_shared: Aggregated usage data, anonymized telemetry, crash logs (may include truncated user identifiers)
Payment information (handled exclusively by third-party payment processor if payments used)
service_providers_processors.note: Mirael does not store raw payment card data

service_providers_processors.data_shared: In response to lawful requests (court orders, subpoenas), to comply with law, to prevent fraud or imminent harm
service_providers_processors.note: We will limit disclosures to the minimum required by law and will notify the user where legally permitted.

sharing_and_disclosures.aggregate_or_deidentified_sharing: We may share aggregated, de-identified, or anonymized usage data for research, product development, or business purposes.

international_transfers.description: Mirael is a global service and may transfer personal data to service providers or processors in other countries. When transfers occur, Mirael implements appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses, data processing agreements, or relying on adequacy decisions where applicable.

measures: Encryption in transit (TLS) for all network communications
Encryption at rest for sensitive data stored on servers and for backups where feasible
Access controls and least privilege for internal systems
Regular security assessments, logging and monitoring of suspicious activity
Hashed and salted storage for authentication credentials (where applicable)
Client-side encryption option: local storage can be encrypted on-device if user enables the feature (where available)
security.breach_response: We maintain an incident response plan. In the event of a data breach that creates a risk to user rights, we will notify affected users and regulators as required by law in the applicable jurisdiction.

data_retention.principle: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose collected or to satisfy legal obligations.

examples.account_data: retained while account is active + 12 months after deactivation (unless legal hold applies)
examples.user_generated_content: retained until user deletes it; copies for backups may persist for up to 90 days
examples.analytics_and_logs: aggregated data kept indefinitely; raw logs and crash reports retained for up to 24 months
examples.local_device_storage: persisted on device until user clears it

rights: Access: Request a copy of personal data.
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Deletion: Request deletion of personal data (subject to retention obligations).
Portability: Receive a machine-readable export of provided personal data (JSON or CSV).
Restrict processing: Ask us to limit certain processing activities.
Object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests or marketing.
Withdraw consent: Withdraw consent for processing that is consent-based.
Opt-out: Opt out of analytics or marketing tracking where provided.

how_to_exercise.method: Submit a request to privacy@mirael.app with proof of identity as required.
how_to_exercise.response_timeline: We will acknowledge all verifiable requests and respond in accordance with applicable law (typically within 30 days; may extend for complex requests where local law allows).

transactional_controls.in_app_controls: Users can view and delete local stored data, disable optional analytics, and turn off certain AI features in settings.
transactional_controls.account_closure: Users can delete their account via Settings > Account > Delete Account. Deletion triggers the removal of account data subject to retention rules and legal obligations.

cookies_and_tracking.description: We and our partners use cookies and similar technologies for session management, product functionality, and analytics.

types.purpose: Product usage metrics and performance optimization
types.opt_out: Available via settings or browser-level controls where applicable

cookies_and_tracking.cookie_policy_location: Within app Settings > Privacy > Cookies & Tracking

children_and_age_restrictions.minimum_age: Mirael is intended for adult users. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16 (or the applicable local age of consent). If we learn we have collected personal data from a child under the applicable age without parental consent, we will delete it.

automated_decision_making_and_profiling.description: Mirael uses automated processing (including AI inference) to generate reflection content, identify cognitive distortions, and surface themes. These processes are assistive and do not make legal, medical, or employment decisions about users.
automated_decision_making_and_profiling.user_rights: Users may request meaningful information about the logic, significance, and envisaged consequences of automated processing and can request human review where applicable.

safety_and_crisis_handling.disclaimer: Mirael is NOT a crisis or emergency service and does not replace professional mental health care.
safety_and_crisis_handling.automated_prompts: If content suggests imminent harm or severe risk, the Service may prompt resources and recommend contacting local emergency services. Such prompts do not constitute monitoring but are safety-oriented.
safety_and_crisis_handling.mandatory_disclosure: If we believe there is an imminent threat to life or safety and are legally compelled to act, we may disclose information to emergency services or authorities as required by law.

international_and_special_jurisdiction_p.eu_gdpr: EU/EEA users may have additional rights. We will respond to GDPR rights requests and provide data processing information relevant to EU residents on request.
international_and_special_jurisdiction_p.ccpa: California residents have rights under the CCPA/CPRA: access, deletion, opt-out of sale (Mirael does not sell personal information). Requests can be made via privacy@mirael.app.

third_party_services.note: We maintain processor agreements and vet security practices for third-party services.

changes_to_policy.description: We may update this Privacy Policy. Significant changes will be posted with a new effective date and, where appropriate, notified to users within the app or by email.

dispute_resolution_and_governing_law.description: Any disputes will be governed by the laws applicable to the entity named as data controller and will follow the terms provided in our Terms of Service. Specific dispute and jurisdictional mechanisms may be provided in the TOS.

steps: User submits request to privacy@mirael.app including type of request and proof of identity.
We respond with the requested data, opportunity to correct, or confirmation of deletion within applicable legal timelines.
For portability requests we provide data in a common machine-readable format (JSON).

retention_timeline_examples.account_inactive: Account + 12 months post-deletion for recovery and fraud prevention

disclaimer_and_limitations: This Privacy Policy is informational and intended to communicate Mirael’s data practices. It does not constitute legal advice. Users and operators should consult counsel for jurisdiction-specific compliance, and Mirael will update implementation details as legal/regulatory requirements evolve.

format_examples.how_to_request: Email privacy@mirael.app or use in-app export function
